text:
tara-cs: Heads-up: NovaPulse asked if we can stand up an APAC (sg) demo ingress for their pilot tomorrow 07:30 SGT. They need an allowlist + an SNI/host header gating rule and a temporary qps increase for the demo. Renewal is 14 days out and customer said positive demo = expanded seat commit. Can we fast-track?
simon-se: What exact numbers and IPs? Also are they expecting proxy peering or direct SNI?
tara-cs: Quick paste from their sysops: want +800 qps for 48h, SNI match for demo.novapulse.ai, and allowlist for two CIDR blocks + one IPv6. They want auto-revoke after 48h and an alert 2h before expiry.

CIDRs:
```
203.119.33.0/27
198.51.100.0/25
2001:db8:600::/64
```
oscar-support: renewal note: NPS 6 last quarter, contract up in 2 weeks. This demo is critical. I'll mark as high touch and loop commercial on success.
maria-sre: Quick capacity check - +800 qps to sg-edge should be OK if we route to apac-sg pool, but we need to reserve ephemeral capacity and enable a per-route token limit to avoid noisy neighbors. Also recommend a soft rate limit (burstable) instead of hard.
simon-se: Security question: SNI match is ok, but SNI can be spoofed if they share certs. Do they control the cert/private key?
tara-cs: Customer confirms they will terminate TLS at their proxy and use SNI header demo.novapulse.ai. They do not want mutual TLS for the demo. Contact is samir@novapulse.ai, attestation uploaded to support ticket.
lee-legal: Please attach their data handling matrix. Are we persisting any raw user content in logs? If yes, we need explicit retention policy.
maria-sre: We can redact payloads from access logs for that route and set retention to 3 days. We'll add an account-level log tag and ensure EU/US controls do not apply; route will be in apac region only.
simon-se: Draft ops steps (hold until legal signoff + attestation):
```
# allowlist CIDRs to sg-edge
redwood edge allowlist add --region apac-sg --cidr 203.119.33.0/27 --account novapulse
redwood edge allowlist add --region apac-sg --cidr 198.51.100.0/25 --account novapulse
redwood edge allowlist add --region apac-sg --cidr 2001:db8:600::/64 --account novapulse
# create host/SNI rule
redwood routes create --account novapulse --region apac-sg --host "demo.novapulse.ai" --route demo-sg-standup
# quota bump
redwood quotas update --account novapulse --route demo-sg-standup --qps +800 --duration 48h --auto-revoke --pre-expiry-alert 2h
# set log redact & retention
redwood logs update --account novapulse --route demo-sg-standup --redact-payload true --retention 72h
```
oscar-support: Filing ticket now.
ticket-bot: Created ticket NF-6127: "NovaPulse sg demo: SNI allowlist + 48h +800 qps" assigned to eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/NF-6127
maria-sre: I'll scope capacity reservation and mark a canary that routes to model-slim if avg token latency > 300ms for 5m. Also will attach a dashboard that tracks per-route p50/p95 latency, qps, error-rate.
simon-se: Ops: can we add a billing note so commercial can track demo overage? Add a temp budget alert at 30% of expected demo spend.
tara-cs: Yes please, commercial wants a spend guard.
oscar-support: Confirmed contact samir@novapulse.ai and attestation present in NF-6127. Legal requested the data matrix; Samir will upload in 30m.
lee-legal: Received data matrix via ticket, ok to proceed with redaction + 72h retention. Add a sentence to ticket: "Logs redacted; no PII stored beyond retention window."
maria-sre: Starting provisioning steps now. Will post job id.
infra-bot: job nf-6127-provision started by maria-sre. estimated 2.2h.
simon-se: Reminder: set up auto-revoke alarm and a post-demo teardown checklist in the ticket so quotas don't linger.
oscar-support: Commercial looped: jenna-sales@redwood.co on standby for upsell follow.
infra-bot: job nf-6127-provision completed - allowlist & host rule added, qps bump applied, auto-revoke scheduled, retention set to 72h. Audit log attached to ticket NF-6127.
maria-sre: Verified route in prod and ran a quick smoke test. p50 = 120ms, p95 = 340ms, activating compact fallback rule if p95>350ms sustained for 3m.
tara-cs: Great — I've scheduled the demo for 07:30 SGT and asked the CSM to run a synthetic load at 07:20 to validate. Will update ticket with demo outcome. :crossed_fingers:
oscar-support: Marked renewal_high_risk = true and set followup task for commercial post-demo.
simon-se: Thanks team. If anything spikes we'll throttle and fallback to model-slim. Keep ticket NF-6127 updated.
